description: Record a review of one saved playlist or one saved school policy. Give playlist_id or policy_id, one and not both, with reviewer (a name), reviewer_type (human, school or ai_verifier) and decision (confirm or reject). note is optional. The review sets the row's trust_state and never its status: a school's confirm sets school_confirmed; a human's or an AI verifier's confirm sets ai_verified and records the reviewer in verified_by; a reject sets rejected. A confirm of a playlist that was already ai_verified counts as a correct result in the weekly audit, and a human's reject of one as a wrong result. A reviewer may not confirm a row it built (its built_by). A run drops the Unverified label only when its playlist and its school policy are both ai_verified or school_confirmed. Returns the review's id and the row's status and trust_state.

note.description: Optional: what the reviewer wants kept with the decision

playlist_id.description: The playlist to review; give this or policy_id, not both

policy_id.description: The school policy to review; give this or playlist_id, not both

reviewer_type.description: Who the reviewer is: a person, the school, or an AI verifier

name: playlist_review
title: Playlist Review
